story.title: 'It hurts a lot' - Carrick 'understands' Man Utd boos after draw
story.summary: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick says boos from the club's fans 'hurts a lot' but that he and his team 'must cope with it' after they conceded a late equaliser to draw 1-1 with Tottenham in the Premier League.
